```python
def transform(grid):
    H = len(grid)
    W = len(grid[0]) if H > 0 else 0

        for c in range(W):
            val = grid[r][c]

            elif val == 6:  # background

                if has_above_2:
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    H = len(grid)
    W = len(grid[0]) if H > 0 else 0
    
    result = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    
    foreground = 9  # demo foreground (maps to test 2)
    mask_color = 3  # adjacent background mapping
    fill_color = 1  # "under" background mapping
    
    # Create a set of all foreground cells for speed
    foreground_cells = set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] == foreground:
                foreground_cells.add((r, c))
    
    # Pass 1: Mark cells that will become 1 (under effect)
    # A cell becomes 1 if there's foreground above it in the same column
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] != 8 and grid[r][c] != foreground:
                continue  # Keep other colors (like 9s don't get overwritten)
            # Check if there's any 8-row foreground above in this column
            has_above = any(grid[i][c] == foreground for i in range(r))
            if has_above:
                result[r][c] = fill_color
    
    # Pass 2: Mark cells that will become 3 (adjacent effect)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if result[r][c] == fill_color:  # already marked as 1
                continue
            if grid[r][c] == foreground or grid[r][c] != 8:
                continue  # keep foreground and non-8 cells
            # Check 8-neighbors for foreground
            is_adjacent = any(
                0 <= nr < H and 0 <= nc < W and 
                grid[nr][nc] == foreground
                for dr, dc in [(r-day, c-week) for r-day, c-week in 
                               [(r-1,c-1), (r-1,c), (r-1,c+1), (r,c-1), (r,c+1), (r+1,c-1), (r+1,c), (r+1,c+1)]]
                )
            else:
                is_adjacent = any(
                    0 <= nr < H and 0 <= nc < W and grid[nr][nc] == foreground
                    for dr, dc in [(r-1,c-1), (r-1,c), (r-1,c+1), (r,c-1), (r,c+1), (r+1,c-1), (r+1,c), (r+1,c+1)]
                )
            
            if is_adjacent:
                result[r][c] = mask_color
    
    return result
```
